notes: Inventory identities use normalized lowercase IDs; mob identity uses original registry ID from EEC source metadata.
Two separate30-level operations. XP levels do not sum to a single60-level charge; do not infer raw XP points without machine/anvil XP rules.
Natural mob availability and per-mob capture/spawn blacklists require runtime verification; recipes are conditional acquisition routes.
All synthetic EEC resources are nonconsumed controller configuration.

patches.name: Prepare Enderman Spawner
patches.machineType: Soul capture → Soul Binder → Anvil → EEC setup
patches.semantics: Output is an existing Powered Spawner with mob NBT installed in EEC controller, not a new craftable item or per-batch consumable.

steps.action: Capture living mob with empty Soul Vial
steps.restrictions: Mob must be living, non-player, allowed by capture blacklist/boss config; NBT id preserves entity type.

steps.action: Soul Binder: retarget Broken Spawner
steps.note: RC2 configured values; no zombie head ingredient.

steps.action: Anvil: combine Powered Spawner + typed Broken Spawner
Install mob-configured Powered Spawner in EEC controller slot

naturalAcquisitionRequirements.method: Break natural mob spawner (survival, allowed tool and mob); RC2 configured drop chance1.0. May instead use an existing Broken Spawner.
Locate and capture the requested mob. This is an acquisition step, not a guessed item recipe.
